title: Fleet Infrastructure Catalog
body: Know what you operate, who owns it, and where the evidence came from.
label: Python · Gradio · SQLAlchemy

title: Inventory is a reconciliation problem
body: Hardware, cluster discovery, and service definitions can disagree. Stable identities, field authority, and source provenance turn conflicting observations into a reviewable view.
label: The problem

title: Preserve the source evidence
body:
SourcesKubernetes, Redfish, and service definitions.
ObservationsStable identities, import digests, presence, and source timestamps.
ReconciliationPer-field authority, provenance, conflicts, and freshness.
DiscoveryOwnership, dependency exposure, audit records, and Backstage export.
label: Architecture

title: One identity, multiple observations
body: Raw source records remain separate from the resolved entity. Imports are transactional and replay-safe. Omitted records retain identity and history; freshness is explicit.
label: Data model

title: Ownership and dependencies stay connected
body: The graph connects 2 clusters, 4 racks, 12 nodes, 6 services, and 3 teams. These fixtures represent 96 GPU slots. Dependency exposure identifies related services and owners, not a predicted outage.
label: Fictional inventory

title: Correctness before scale claims
body: Tests cover authority, conflicts, missing records, stale sources, import replay, rollback, cycle-safe traversal, source normalization, API access, and Gradio exports. PostgreSQL checks verify reconciliation after restart.
label: Verification

title: Scaling follows measured bottlenecks
body: Incremental projections, paginated queries, bounded graph traversal, source checkpoints, and durable ingestion jobs address growth. Preserve snapshot completeness and provenance across every change.
label: Design considerations

title: A standalone catalog foundation
body: The project owns inventory, reconciliation, audit records, and Backstage export. Telemetry experiments live in a separate repository. No telemetry process is required to run the catalog.
label: Scope
